metadata.description: Give Claude a memory of the YouTube videos you watch — transcribe, remember, search, and turn them into summaries, highlights and decks.

plugins.name: yt-mem-ai
plugins.description: A local YouTube memory: fetches transcripts (captions, Whisper fallback), keeps them searchable on your machine, and writes summaries, timestamped highlights, Q&A, decks and daily digests. Ships the yt + yt-agent skills and /yt-* commands; no API key.
